identity.title: Siyu An
identity.headline: Software Engineer · cloud-platform engineering & operations
identity.tagline: I am a Software Engineer specializing in cloud‑platform engineering and operations. My primary focus is building, scaling and maintaining Kubernetes‑based infrastructures that power highly available, automated network and security services across hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. I work at the intersection of platform automation, cluster operations and cloud resource optimization—leveraging container orchestration (Kubernetes, Helm), observability pipelines and cost‑/performance‑driven decisions.

experience.name: INFOBLOX
experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Engineered a high-throughput DNS logging pipeline in Go (DNSTAP + syslog over TCP/TLS) with WAL-backed buffering to handle backpressure at 10K QPS, reducing log loss from 1% to <0.3% and cutting router CPU usage by 42%.

Orchestrated a CloudQuery-powered multi-cloud DNS state ingestion fabric integrating Cloudflare and Akamai to unify configuration topology across hybrid environments, operationalizing 200+ enterprise networks and driving a 22% uplift in feature adoption.

Extended BloxOne DDI by implementing RPZ-based DNS response filtering and Stub Zone support in Kubernetes-native Go services, improving security enforcement and zone resolution consistency across distributed deployments.

Introduced an MCP-powered CI/CD orchestration system that enables safe AI-assisted deployments through structured runbooks and guardrails, reducing manual release effort by 80% and improving cross-team release consistency.

Implemented a Go-based static analysis tool to analyze multi-repository dependency graphs and detect inconsistent imports across services, reducing cross-service review overhead and improving dependency alignment.

experience.name: BEST_ENERGY_EQUIPMENT
